title: First Blood in the Caribbean
intro_text: Your fleet has arrived at the contested waters.
Enemy privateers have taken position near the islands.
This is a small skirmish to test your naval tactics.
victory_text: Victory! The enemy fleet has been sent to Davy Jones' locker.
Your seamanship has won the day.
defeat_text: Defeat. Your ships have been overwhelmed.
Return to port and try a different strategy.
